key_points: Meta launched Muse AI agent and a new AI‑centric subscription service, seen as a potential growth catalyst
Free cash flow fell ~90% due to heavy AI capex, raising near‑term cash‑flow concerns
Insider buying and BofA reiterating Buy add support, while a product chief’s share sale and a 7% intraday drop create short‑term pressure
Dividend announcement provides modest yield but may not offset cash‑flow worries
Overall sentiment leans positive but impact is moderate and likely plays out over the next few weeks
